title: Hostless runners pin an Engram whose source_id shape differs from Central's, so their gate values cannot be compared with Central-recorded ones
outcome: Every landing-gate runner produces a source_id in the same shape as the integration owner records, so a gate's request/before/after values compare literally with the recorded value.
acceptance: The hostless runners (DL560 C6/C7, Windows B) and Central produce the same source_id shape for the same clean commit, or the landing procedure names which producer's shape is the recorded one per gate.
The procedure for recording a candidate's complete source_id before a test-ref push names the producer binary and its build.
